name: Sale To POI Device Request V 08
definition: The SaleTOPOIDeviceRequest message is sent by the sale system to POI system to request a device service.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

DeviceRequest.name: Device Request
DeviceRequest.definition: Information related to a device request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
